verdict.rationale: Convex's pricing page lists "Daily backups" as a plan feature, which covers the automated-backup half of the story. However, it is only a single bullet with no documentation of retention, restore procedure, or which tier includes it. Point-in-time recovery is not evidenced at all, and the CLI export/import commands are manual data movement rather than automated backup or PITR. Missing for 10: point-in-time recovery, documented restore workflow, backup retention/frequency details, tier availability clarity, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on automated backups and point-in-time recovery for my data

citations.quote: Log streaming, Exception reporting, HIPAA/SOC 2 reports, Daily backups, Custom domains, Email support
